name: app-red-gradient-workflow-timeline-slide
title: Red Gradient Workflow Timeline
whatItIs: A case-study slide on a deep red vignette showing four workflow phases as staggered horizontal bars: solid red blocks for active steps and fine hatch lines for the remaining track.
whatItMeans: Staggering the bars makes time visible as progress across the page, and the vignette adds drama to what could be a dry process diagram.
techniques: Staircase of bars where each phase starts where the last ends
Solid blocks versus fine vertical hatching to show done versus remaining
Tiny labels under each segment for sub-steps
Monochrome red with a dark vignette
Lots of empty space so the timeline reads at a glance

vocabulary.definition: Bars offset diagonally to suggest sequence.
A field of thin lines used as an empty progress track.
A darkening toward the edges of an image.
